text: This report recommends the appointment of five public members to the George Bell Arena Board.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following three candidates to the George Bell Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on June 23, 2025, and until successors are appointed: Michael Casey Wendell Noel Charlene Patfield 2. Appointed the following two candidates to the George Bell Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on February 28, 2027, and until successors are appointed: Andrew Burnell Tanya Connors
